description: Software is not maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for outdated software versions, missing security patches, unsupported software still in use, lack of software lifecycle management, failure to remove deprecated applications, and inadequate vulnerability remediation processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
